scene: The brass key opens a street-corner registry listing three scenic departures.
picture: Side-scrolling view along the bustling canal road. On the far left, a wooden koi-shaped canal boat rocks at a stone mooring. Left of centre, the grandfather holds his bicycle with plant crate beside an unlocked brass departures registry. Up high overhead sits a garden tram on elevated tracks. Far right, the sleek red bento express waits at a ticket turnstile.
shown: A docked wooden koi-shaped canal boat floating at a low wooden pier on the far left.
A leaf-covered green garden tram idling at a raised brass platform up high.
A sleek bento express railcar with steam puffing from its red roof on the far right.
